children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. reported results for the first quarter ended Aug. 31, 2026, with revenue of $1.99M, a modest increase versus $1.89M in the year-ago quarter, and a net loss of $6.84M, or diluted EPS of $(0.02), compared with net income of $0.76M and EPS of $0 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue: $1.986M for Q1 ended Aug 31, 2026, up from $1.889M in the year-ago quarter (5% YoY).
Net income: $(6.838M) loss for Q1 ended Aug 31, 2026, versus $0.763M income in the year-ago quarter (swing to loss).
Diluted EPS: $(0.02) for Q1 ended Aug 31, 2026, compared with $0.00 in the year-ago quarter.
Total revenue rose modestly year over year, driven by growth in rental and direct sales despite the loss of a large customer.
Channel footprint expanded: more than 100 dealers plus direct sales supported deployments of roughly 1,000 devices across the U.S., Canada and EU.
SARA platform momentum: integration with Immix and maintained SOC 2 Type 2 compliance since February 2025, strengthening channel credibility.
Product and deployment progress: commercial recurring billing for ROAMEO mobile patrols began in May 2026, with two units deployed and billing.
Operational focus shifted from retail hardware toward software initiatives; manufacturing remains in Ferndale, MI, with engineering support in Sri Lanka.
